text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time, Trainer. The opening 
bell will ring any moment now...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it. I wonder what 
kind of sight awaits beyond the curtain 
today.
choice_data_list:
Isn't the usual course what's waiting for 
us?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That is true. But depending on the 
runners and their tactics, the performance 
can change dramatically."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"From the opponent's sense of timing, and 
on top of that, their ad-libbing."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That is the terror of a live show. And 
what makes it so thrilling...!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my heart won't stop pounding...! I 
have a feeling today's race will be a 
truly wonderful one.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come, Trainer-san. No two performances are 
ever the same. Let's give our fans a 
once-in-a-lifetime masterpiece!
